text: Imagine you discover a box filled with objects you collected as a small child. Describe some of the
objects, and your thoughts and feelings as you look at them.
OR
Imagine you are waiting in a café for a friend who is very late. Describe your surroundings and
your thoughts and feelings as you wait.
OR
Narrative Writing
Write a story entitled, ‘The New Beginning’.
